description: Scrape comments and full reply threads from TikTok videos. Provide video URLs/IDs and/or profiles.

deepWalk.description: Read TikTok's app-style view of the comment list, which reaches far more comments on many videos, and restore image/sticker data from the standard view per comment. Off keeps the standard walk.
deepWalk.title: Deep walk (higher comment coverage)

includeCommenterDetails.description: Add the commenter's region code and bio to user.region / user.bio, matched by comment ID from TikTok's app-style view of the page.
includeCommenterDetails.title: Include commenter details (region, bio)

includeCommenterStats.description: Add exact follower, following, heart and video counts to user.* for every commenter. Each commenter's public profile is looked up once; private or banned accounts are omitted.
includeCommenterStats.title: Include commenter follower counts

includeReplies.description: Fetch the reply thread under each root comment and emit each reply as its own row right after its parent.
includeReplies.title: Include replies

includeVideoMetadata.description: Add a 'video' object (caption, author, view/like/comment counts) to every row.
includeVideoMetadata.title: Include video metadata

maxCommenterLookups.description: Cap on how many commenters are enriched when 'Include commenter follower counts' is on. Set to 0 for no cap.
maxCommenterLookups.title: Max commenter lookups

maxCommentsPerPost.description: Maximum number of rows per video, counting replies when 'Include replies' is on. The actor walks the comment section as deep as TikTok serves it.
maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max comment rows per video

maxItems.description: Global cap on the number of rows in the run (comments + replies). Set to 0 for no global cap.
maxItems.title: Max total rows

maxRepliesPerComment.description: Cap the replies fetched for any single root comment. Set to 0 for all replies (still bounded by 'Max comment rows per video').
maxRepliesPerComment.title: Max replies per comment

maxVideosPerProfile.description: How many of each profile's newest videos to scrape comments from.
maxVideosPerProfile.title: Max videos per profile

minLikes.description: Only keep comments and replies with at least this many likes. Comments below the threshold are skipped before their replies are fetched.
minLikes.title: Minimum likes

postIds.description: Numeric TikTok video IDs (15-20 digits) as an alternative to URLs.
postIds.title: Video IDs

postUrls.description: TikTok video or photo URLs to scrape comments from (e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/123...).
postUrls.title: Video URLs

profiles.description: TikTok usernames or profile URLs. The actor scrapes comments from their newest videos, up to 'Max videos per profile'.
profiles.title: Profiles (comments on their newest videos)

title: TikTok Comment & Reply Thread Extractor Input
